objective: sum over plants and hours of (fuel_cost + health_cost) * output + operating_cost * on + startup_cost * start + shutdown_cost * stop (costs by the plant's fuel)

hour.description: Hour of 1 July 2011 (1 = midnight to 1 am); consecutive hours are linked by ramp limits and start-ups
hour.label: hour

demand_mwh.description: Power demand in Georgia in the hour; generation must equal it
demand_mwh.label: hourly power demand (MWh)

plant.description: Plant or group of merged plants
plant.label: power plant

plant_type.description: COAL, NUCLEAR, OIL, BIOMASS, GAS, HYDRO or OTHER COAL
plant_type.label: plant type

fuel.description: Fuel code; sets the plant's costs
fuel.label: fuel

capacity_mwh.description: Most the plant can generate in an hour
capacity_mwh.label: generation capacity (MWh per hour)

ramp_fraction.description: Most the output may change from one hour to the next (1 = no limit)
ramp_fraction.label: hourly ramp limit fraction

must_run.description: 1 = must generate at least its minimum output every hour (the nuclear plants). To drop it, relax must_run
must_run.label: must-run flag

fuel.description: SUB subbituminous coal, BIT bituminous coal, NUC nuclear, BLQ black liquor, NG natural gas, WAT water
fuel.label: fuel

fuel_cost.description: Fuel cost per MWh generated (2011 average)
fuel_cost.label: fuel cost per MWh

operating_cost.description: Cost of each hour a plant is on
operating_cost.label: operating cost per hour on

startup_cost.description: Cost of switching a plant on
startup_cost.label: start-up cost

shutdown_cost.description: Cost of switching a plant off
shutdown_cost.label: shut-down cost

plant.description: Plant (only the three named coal plants have rows)
plant.label: power plant

health_cost.description: Health damage cost per MWh generated in the hour; a missing row means 0
health_cost.label: health cost per MWh

decision_variables.on[plant, hour]: binary, 1 if the plant is on
decision_variables.start[plant, hour]: binary, 1 if the plant is switched on in the hour
decision_variables.stop[plant, hour]: binary, 1 if the plant is switched off in the hour

constraints.must_run[plant, hour]: must-run plants only: output >= min_output_fraction * capacity_mwh
constraints.ramp_down[plant, hour]: from hour 2: output - previous output >= -ramp_fraction * capacity_mwh
constraints.ramp_up[plant, hour]: from hour 2: output - previous output <= ramp_fraction * capacity_mwh
constraints.switch[plant, hour]: from hour 2: start - stop = on - previous on
